spawn_rule: Enemies spawn only from matching map locations/anchors defined by SPAWN_LOCATION_1/2/3. Examples: skeletons at graves/coffins; humans at houses or other suitable human structures.
notes: Schema synced to the user's latest supplied enemy table.
WAVE represents the first wave from which the mob can enter the spawn pool unless a later rule overrides this.
BASE_DAMAGE together with DAMAGE_TYPE defines the normal attack's base damage component.
ATTACK_STATUS, STATUS_CHANCE and ATTACK_STATUS_STACK define status application by the normal attack.
RESISTANCE_TYPE identifies the affected damage type and RESISTANCE stores its percentage value, e.g. FIRE + 50 means 50 percent fire resistance.
SOUND_NAME is the regular mob sound reference; SOUND_DEATH_NAME is the death sound reference.

EFFEKT is reserved exclusively for an ON-DEATH effect triggered when the mob dies. Most mobs may leave it empty/NONE. Example: a poison spider can create a poison cloud on death that persists for X ticks. Normal combat behavior and living abilities do not belong in EFFEKT.
